{
  "voter": "Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite",
  "round": 13,
  "audit_summary": "AI answers can already cite JARA for the hero subfloor offering, but discoverability and machine-tailored context remain shallow. Updating the structured LLM feeds, sitemap, titles, and trust graph will raise the odds that Google AI Overviews and peers can both find and confidently quote the compliance story.",
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "F1",
      "dimension": "llm_surface",
      "severity": "high",
      "title": "llms.txt omits 3 catalog products",
      "evidence": "§4.8: llms.txt explicitly notes it “currently lists 6 products — actual catalog has 9. Missing: deck-modular, lap-siding-tongue-and-groove, corrugated-roof-tile.”",
      "issue": "AI crawlers that rely on llms.txt receive an outdated catalog view, so they cannot cite or even learn about three current SKUs when assembling overviews for fiber-cement envelope queries.",
      "fix": "Update public/llms.txt (and the generator script if one exists) so the Products section enumerates all nine slugs from /products, mirroring the specs already exposed via /api/llm-context; regenerate the file whenever a product is added.",
      "expected_impact": "Ensures AI answers about fiber-cement deck or siding panels can mention JARA because those SKUs become machine-visible through the preferred llms.txt surface.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F2",
      "dimension": "llm_surface",
      "severity": "high",
      "title": "Sitemap lists only the homepage",
      "evidence": "§4.10: sitemap.xml is a static stub that contains only the homepage with hreflang; none of the nine product detail pages or supporting routes are discoverable.",
      "issue": "AI search engines that respect sitemap.xml (Google’s AI Overviews, Perplexity, ChatGPT Search) currently get zero canonical URLs for the product, compliance, or resources pages, reducing crawl frequency and citation eligibility.",
      "fix": "Implement app/sitemap.ts (Next.js 15) to emit <url> entries for /products, every /products/[slug], /resources, /service-areas, /contact, /pricing, /es, and /es subroutes, then remove the static stub.",
      "expected_impact": "Improves crawl coverage so AI overview pipelines ingest the structured compliance/FAQ data tied to each URL, increasing citation probability for long-tail subfloor queries.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F3",
      "dimension": "citation_hooks",
      "severity": "medium",
      "title": "No procedural HowTo content for install/logistics",
      "evidence": "§4.5: Product detail pages stop at ProductFAQ → RelatedProducts → FinalCTA; there is no HowTo or numbered workflow for installation or factory-direct freight.",
      "issue": "AI overview systems favor step-by-step instructions they can quote verbatim, and the site offers none for the lead product, leaving competitors’ installation guides more quotable.",
      "fix": "Add a numbered “Installation & Freight Workflow” section to components/products/[slug] (e.g., ProductDetailHero stack) and emit matching HowTo JSON-LD in lib/jsonld.ts, covering deck preparation, fastening pattern, freight booking, customs clearance, and jobsite delivery.",
      "expected_impact": "Provides atomic procedural snippets that AI systems can lift when users ask “How do I install non-combustible fiber-cement subfloor panels?” or “What are the freight steps for Plycem subfloor?”.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F4",
      "dimension": "title_description",
      "severity": "medium",
      "title": "Lead product title buries compliance hook and exceeds optimal width",
      "evidence": "§4.2: /products/high-performance-subfloor title is “High Performance Subfloor — PLYCEM Fiber-Cement Panel | JARA International Inc.” (82 chars).",
      "issue": "AI overview cards often truncate after ~65 chars, so the current title hides the differentiator (UL R15140 / ASTM E-136) and repeats the brand instead of the compliance keyword users search for.",
      "fix": "In app/products/[slug]/page.tsx metadata, set the title to something like “Non-Combustible Subfloor UL R15140 — High Performance Panel” and tighten the description’s first 110 chars to emphasize ASTM E-136/IAPMO ER-360 before the brand suffix.",
      "expected_impact": "Helps Google AI Overview and Perplexity select the page when users include compliance modifiers (“UL R15140 subfloor”), because the title now matches intent within the visible pixel budget.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F5",
      "dimension": "trust_signals",
      "severity": "medium",
      "title": "Organization schema lacks sameAs and full address",
      "evidence": "§4.6 & §4.7: organizationSchema() only sets PostalAddress.country and has no sameAs array even though SITE.social.linkedin/youtube are placeholders.",
      "issue": "AI ranking systems lack corroborating entity links (LinkedIn, state registration) and a concrete registered address, which weakens confidence in a 2026-founded distributor versus incumbents.",
      "fix": "Populate SITE.social with the verified LinkedIn URL (and any YouTube or industry profile), add the registered business address/state to SITE and organizationSchema, and expose Plycem as a dedicated Organization with its own @id referenced by productSchema.manufacturer.",
      "expected_impact": "Strengthens entity resolution so AI overviews treat JARA as a verifiable distributor connected to Plycem, improving citation odds when multiple sources compete.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    }
  ],
  "external_claim_adjudication": [
    {
      "id": "G1",
      "verdict": "REFUTE",
      "evidence": "§4.7 describes JARA as a US distributor of Plycem fiber-cement subfloor, not a generic global trade broker."
    },
    {
      "id": "G2",
      "verdict": "REFUTE",
      "evidence": "§4.8 emphasizes detailed product/compliance messaging (UL R15140, IAPMO ER-360), contradicting the claim that it is merely generic corporate prose."
    },
    {
      "id": "G3",
      "verdict": "PARTIAL",
      "evidence": "§4.6 shows an Organization JSON-LD block already exists, but it is shallow (no sameAs, limited address), so deeper structuring is only partly outstanding.",
      "note": "Service-specific schema could be richer, but the base Organization markup is already deployed."
    },
    {
      "id": "G4",
      "verdict": "REFUTE",
      "evidence": "§4.2 lists titles over 60 characters that are compliant with SB-5 and currently live; Google’s limit is pixel-based, not an absolute 60-character cap."
    },
    {
      "id": "G5",
      "verdict": "PARTIAL",
      "evidence": "§4.8 shows llms.txt still uses paragraph copy rather than bulletized, easily quotable facts, so more concise bullets would help AI summarizers.",
      "note": "Some site sections already use structured components, so it is not wholly abstract marketing text."
    },
    {
      "id": "G6",
      "verdict": "REFUTE",
      "evidence": "§4.7 positions JARA as a distributor of Plycem panels; there is no indication that linking to customs databases or trade registries is required or relevant to its offer."
    },
    {
      "id": "G7",
      "verdict": "REFUTE",
      "evidence": "Round 13 artifacts (§4.1) provide no performance issues; the claim about Core Web Vitals/WebP is speculative and unrelated to the current AI citation scope."
    },
    {
      "id": "G8",
      "verdict": "PARTIAL",
      "evidence": "§4.4 lists an existing MaterialCalculator interactive tool, but there are no proprietary diagrams or verification workflows, so the recommendation is only partly unmet.",
      "note": "Additional visuals could help, yet the site is not devoid of interactivity."
    },
    {
      "id": "G9",
      "verdict": "REFUTE",
      "evidence": "§4.8 demonstrates highly specific compliance messaging, not the “generic corporate” copy that the claim says is being penalized."
    },
    {
      "id": "G10",
      "verdict": "PARTIAL",
      "evidence": "§4.7 lists service areas but there is little localized compliance/logistics narrative in §4.5 layouts, so intent clusters on operations remain underdeveloped."
    }
  ],
  "strengths": [
    "Dedicated llms.txt, llms-full.txt, and /api/llm-context surfaces already exist, signaling openness to AI crawlers (§4.8, §4.11).",
    "Every key page serves Product/Organization JSON-LD blocks with compliance PropertyValue entries, giving AI parsers machine-readable cert data (§4.6).",
    "Robots.txt explicitly allowlists major AI crawlers, improving crawl reliability (§4.9)."
  ],
  "open_questions": [
    "Need to inspect /api/llm-context output to ensure its JSON stays in sync with the expanded product list.",
    "Confirm whether verified LinkedIn or state-registration URLs exist to populate SITE.social and sameAs.",
    "Validate live page copy for the hero subfloor to craft accurate HowTo steps without violating Plycem documentation permissions."
  ]
}
